sentences.en: Transformation is birth and death at the same time.
After the transformation she did not notice any change on herself.
sentences.zh: 经过转变后，她没有发现自己有任何改变。

sentences.en: In Spanish, there are many different expressions to indicate changes and transformations.
sentences.zh: 在西班牙语中，有许多不同的表达方式来表示变化和转换。
